name: Code Health Gate
description: Turns the dead-code / duplicate / type-escape scans into a quality gate for phases that change code. When an Implement or Fix session starts, startTaskPhase fires deps.onPhaseStart → codeHealth.captureHealthBaseline, which runs scanHost.scanHealthSnapshot (all three scans, fingerprints only, NEVER persisting findings files) and stores it under globalStorage/task-health/<repoKey>/<taskId>.json. When the bound session reports notify_done, registerAutopilot awaits deps.onPhaseDone → codeHealth.recordHealthDelta BEFORE autopilot decides: it re-scans, diffs per fingerprint (new minus gone, so the delta is scoped to what the phase changed; the scans themselves cover the whole worktree) and idempotently writes "Code health: +N duplicates, -M dead-code items, ±K type escapes" into the task memo. The Phase Board card shows a health chip (red ▲ when any count is positive) parsed from that memo line; the Review procedure tells the session to file a review-finding per positive regression. Setting: codeWorkbench.codeHealth.scanOnPhaseDone (default true). Baseline capture is fire-and-forget, so it can race the session's first edits on very large repos.
guidelines: Health scans must not persist findings files (that is the host's on-demand contract in shared-scan-service).
The memo line is replaced idempotently via upsertHealthLine; the chip parses the same 'Code health:' prefix.
onPhaseDone is awaited before autopilot so the next phase sees the delta.
anti_patterns: Do not gate Plan/Review/Ship phases — only phases that change code.
